visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera captures the exterior of a dark maroon sightseeing train named 'Aoniyoshi' stationary at a station platform. The train features elegant gold floral emblems and lettering. A few commuters and station staff are visible in the background on the tiled platform under bright artificial lighting. (2) The scene transitions to the train's interior, showing a luxurious aisle with golden archway structures overhead and a patterned green carpet. A passenger in a mask walks towards the camera. The lighting is warm and emphasizes the metallic gold textures. (3) The camera explores the seating arrangements, first showing a four-person booth with deep red velvet armchairs and a small table with a blue lamp. It then cuts to rows of bright green velvet lounge seats with high headrests, arranged in pairs facing the window. (4) The focus moves to a service counter area where a male and a female staff member, both in vests and masks, stand ready to serve. The counter has a light wood finish and displays various menus and snack items. (5) Close-up shots feature regional Nara snacks, including colorful tin cans with train illustrations and a cup of purple-colored dessert. A hand is seen holding a package of three decorative tins against the window background. (6) A young woman with dark hair, wearing a white sweater and a gold chain bag, is shown sitting by the wide window. She is holding a clear cup and taking a sip of a beverage while the rural landscape of green fields and trees moves past. (7) Technical features like a wall-mounted AC power outlet are highlighted. The final sequence shows more exterior landscape views through the large train windows, featuring open fields and power lines under a clear sky.
